theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  rw [HomBisimilarity.symm_simulation]
  exists @ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, .choice h
  refine ⟨⟨?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rintro _ _ (h|h)
    · exact .choice h.symm
    · exact .bisim h.symm
  · rintro a b (hpq|hpq) μ c htr
    · cases htr with
      | choiceL htr => exact (hpq.follow_fst htr).imp fun _ => And.imp Tr.choiceL ChoiceBisim.bisim
      | choiceR htr => exact ⟨_, Tr.choiceR htr, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
    · exact (hpq.follow_fst htr).imp fun _ => And.imp_right ChoiceBisim.bisim
